items.headline: NRC holds second License to Launch workshop on DOE-to-NRC licensing
items.what_happened: The NRC held the second workshop in its 'License to Launch' series, 'Building the Bridge: From DOE Authorization to NRC Licensing', on 2026-10-28 from 12:30 to 4:30 pm EDT. It was an information meeting with Q&A covering the DOE authorization process, the proposed expedited NRC route for DOE-authorized reactor designs, and early NRC staff thinking on reusing information from DOE authorization.
items.why_it_matters: A 1-20 MW reactor authorized first by DOE would move to a commercial NRC license through this route. The workshop shows how much DOE work NRC expects to reuse, which bears on how long a buyer waits for a license. The rule itself is already on the News tab (2026-10-22).
items.binding_note: Public information meeting with Q&A. No decision, filing or order.
